// GgsRigPlayer: plays a GGS rig package in Unity (2021.3+). Generated by ggs; safe to edit.
// Setup: drop parts.png and <name>.ggsrig.json into Assets, add this component to an empty GameObject,
// assign Rig Json + Atlas, press Play. The GameObject's origin is the ground point under the character.
// Units: package pixels / pixelsPerUnit. Unity is +y up, so y and angles are negated from the package.
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Ggs
{
    [Serializable] public class GgsRect { public float x, y, w, h; }
    [Serializable] public class GgsBone { public string name; public string parent; public float length; public float attach; }
    [Serializable] public class GgsPart
    {
        public string name; public string[] bones; public GgsRect rect; public float pivotX, pivotY;
        public float artAngle; public float lengthPx; public float farTint;
    }
    [Serializable] public class GgsVariant { public string name; public string part; public GgsRect rect; public float pivotX, pivotY; }
    [Serializable] public class GgsItem
    {
        public string name; public string bone; public GgsRect rect; public float pivotX, pivotY;
        public float artAngle, holdAngle, socketT, socketOffset;
    }
    [Serializable] public class GgsFloatTrack { public string bone; public float[] values; }
    [Serializable] public class GgsIntTrack { public string bone; public int[] values; }
    [Serializable] public class GgsClip
    {
        public string name; public float fps; public int frameCount; public bool loop; public float loopTravelPx;
        public float[] rootX; public float[] rootY; public GgsFloatTrack[] local; public GgsIntTrack[] drawIndex;
    }
    [Serializable] public class GgsRigData
    {
        public string format; public int version; public string name; public float heightPx; public int atlasW, atlasH;
        public GgsBone[] bones; public GgsPart[] parts; public GgsVariant[] headVariants; public GgsItem[] items;
        public string[] drawOrder;
        public GgsClip[] clips;
    }

    public class GgsRigPlayer : MonoBehaviour
    {
        public TextAsset rigJson;
        public Texture2D atlas;
        public string clipName = "";
        public float pixelsPerUnit = 100f;
        public float speed = 1f;
        public bool playOnStart = true;
        public string sortingLayerName = "Default";
        public int sortingOrderBase = 0;

        GgsRigData data;
        readonly Dictionary<string, Transform> boneT = new Dictionary<string, Transform>();
        readonly Dictionary<string, SpriteRenderer> art = new Dictionary<string, SpriteRenderer>();
        readonly Dictionary<string, SpriteRenderer> variants = new Dictionary<string, SpriteRenderer>();
        readonly Dictionary<string, int> baseOrder = new Dictionary<string, int>();
        string headBone;
        GgsClip clip;
        float time;
        bool playing;

        public GgsRigData Data { get { return data; } }
        public float LoopTravelUnits { get { return clip == null ? 0f : clip.loopTravelPx / pixelsPerUnit; } }

        void Awake()
        {
            if (rigJson == null || atlas == null) { Debug.LogError("GgsRigPlayer: assign Rig Json and Atlas", this); enabled = false; return; }
            data = JsonUtility.FromJson<GgsRigData>(rigJson.text);
            if (data == null || data.format != "ggs.unity_rig") { Debug.LogError("GgsRigPlayer: not a ggs.unity_rig file", this); enabled = false; return; }
            Build();
            Play(string.IsNullOrEmpty(clipName) && data.clips.Length > 0 ? data.clips[0].name : clipName);
            playing = playOnStart;
            Apply(0f);
        }

        Sprite MakeSprite(GgsRect r, float px, float py)
        {
            // package rects are top-left based; Unity textures are bottom-left based
            var rect = new Rect(r.x, atlas.height - r.y - r.h, r.w, r.h);
            var pivot = new Vector2(px / r.w, 1f - py / r.h);
            return Sprite.Create(atlas, rect, pivot, pixelsPerUnit, 0, SpriteMeshType.FullRect);
        }

        SpriteRenderer MakeArt(Transform bone, string name, Sprite sprite, GgsPart part, float tint, int order)
        {
            var go = new GameObject(name);
            go.transform.SetParent(bone, false);
            go.transform.localRotation = Quaternion.Euler(0f, 0f, part.artAngle);
            var bd = Array.Find(data.bones, b => b.name == bone.name);
            float s = part.lengthPx > 0f ? bd.length / part.lengthPx : 1f;
            go.transform.localScale = new Vector3(s, s, 1f);
            var sr = go.AddComponent<SpriteRenderer>();
            sr.sprite = sprite;
            sr.color = new Color(tint, tint, tint, 1f);
            sr.sortingLayerName = sortingLayerName;
            sr.sortingOrder = sortingOrderBase + order;
            return sr;
        }

        void Build()
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < data.drawOrder.Length; i++) baseOrder[data.drawOrder[i]] = i;
            foreach (var b in data.bones)  // parents come first
            {
                var go = new GameObject(b.name);
                Transform parent = string.IsNullOrEmpty(b.parent) ? transform : boneT[b.parent];
                go.transform.SetParent(parent, false);
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(b.parent))
                {
                    float plen = Array.Find(data.bones, x => x.name == b.parent).length;
                    go.transform.localPosition = new Vector3(0f, -b.attach * plen / pixelsPerUnit, 0f);
                }
                boneT[b.name] = go.transform;
            }
            foreach (var p in data.parts)
            {
                var sprite = MakeSprite(p.rect, p.pivotX, p.pivotY);
                for (int i = 0; i < p.bones.Length; i++)
                {
                    string bone = p.bones[i];
                    art[bone] = MakeArt(boneT[bone], "art", sprite, p, i == 0 ? 1f : p.farTint, baseOrder[bone]);
                    if (i == 0 && p.name == "head") headBone = bone;
                    if (i == 0 && p.name == "head" && data.headVariants != null)
                        foreach (var v in data.headVariants)
                        {
                            var vr = MakeArt(boneT[bone], "art_" + v.name, MakeSprite(v.rect, v.pivotX, v.pivotY), p, 1f, baseOrder[bone]);
                            vr.enabled = false;
                            variants[v.name] = vr;
                        }
                }
            }
            if (data.items != null)
                foreach (var it in data.items)  // held items: fixed on the hand at their socket, above every part
                {
                    var go = new GameObject("item_" + it.name);
                    go.transform.SetParent(boneT[it.bone], false);
                    float len = Array.Find(data.bones, x => x.name == it.bone).length / pixelsPerUnit;
                    go.transform.localPosition = new Vector3(-it.socketOffset * len, -it.socketT * len, 0f);
                    go.transform.localRotation = Quaternion.Euler(0f, 0f, it.artAngle - it.holdAngle);
                    var sr = go.AddComponent<SpriteRenderer>();
                    sr.sprite = MakeSprite(it.rect, it.pivotX, it.pivotY);
                    sr.sortingLayerName = sortingLayerName;
                    sr.sortingOrder = sortingOrderBase + data.drawOrder.Length;
                }
        }

        public void Play(string name)
        {
            clip = Array.Find(data.clips, c => c.name == name);
            if (clip == null) { Debug.LogError("GgsRigPlayer: no clip " + name, this); return; }
            time = 0f;
            playing = true;
        }

        public void Stop() { playing = false; }

        /// <summary>Show a head variant (blink, mouth_open, hurt) or null for the normal head.</summary>
        public void SetHeadVariant(string variant)
        {
            foreach (var kv in variants) kv.Value.enabled = kv.Key == variant;
            if (headBone != null) art[headBone].enabled = variant == null || !variants.ContainsKey(variant);
        }

        void Update()
        {
            if (!playing || clip == null) return;
            time += Time.deltaTime * speed;
            Apply(time);
        }

        static float Lerp(float[] v, int i0, int i1, float a) { return v[i0] + (v[i1] - v[i0]) * a; }

        void Apply(float t)
        {
            if (clip == null || clip.frameCount == 0) return;
            int n = clip.frameCount;
            float f = t * clip.fps;
            if (clip.loop) { f %= n; if (f < 0f) f += n; } else f = Mathf.Clamp(f, 0f, n - 1);
            int i0 = Mathf.FloorToInt(f);
            float a = f - i0;
            int i1 = i0 + 1;
            if (i1 >= n) i1 = clip.loop ? 0 : n - 1;

            var root = boneT[data.bones[0].name];
            root.localPosition = new Vector3(Lerp(clip.rootX, i0, i1, a) / pixelsPerUnit,
                                             -Lerp(clip.rootY, i0, i1, a) / pixelsPerUnit, 0f);
            foreach (var tr in clip.local)
            {
                float ang = Mathf.LerpAngle(tr.values[i0], tr.values[i1], a);
                boneT[tr.bone].localRotation = Quaternion.Euler(0f, 0f, -ang);
            }
            if (clip.drawIndex != null)
                foreach (var tr in clip.drawIndex)
                    art[tr.bone].sortingOrder = sortingOrderBase + tr.values[i0];
        }
    }
}
